linkedin.hook: Formal verification for Blend v2 b-tokens changes the credit risk dynamic on Soroban.
linkedin.copy:
Pooled risk models in money markets routinely penalize sophisticated credit strategies. When users interact with tokenized debt vouchers like Blend v2 b-tokens, shared liquidation pools expose passive yield to bad debt contagion. Formal verification of the underlying state transitions solves the verification layer, but runtime isolation is where solvency is actually protected.

By packaging collateralized debt positions inside isolated SmartAccount sandboxes on Soroban, leverage is separated directly at the execution layer. The host account owns the asset, manages the rebalance criteria, and bounds liquidation parameters without tapping shared balance sheets. Operating with ~320ms Mercury indexer latency and predictable 0.00014 XLM gas fees, high-frequency collateral rebalancing becomes deterministic rather than reactive.

We enforce a strict 1.10x Health Factor floor across all b-token routing logic to guarantee orderly unwinds even under volatile market swings. The architecture is deployed on Stellar testnet. Builders and credit analysts can deploy a testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance.

reddit.hook: Dissecting Blend v2 formal verification and how we are using b-tokens for isolated leverage on Soroban testnet
reddit.copy:
Most yield routing on money markets falls apart when you try to loop yield-bearing collateral. Either you run into sudden pool-wide liquidations or high gas fees eat up your arb margins. With Blend v2 releasing formally verified pool contracts, we finally have mathematical guarantees around pool solvency and b-token exchange rates. 

The challenge with b-tokens is safe execution under leverage. If you loop collateral inside pooled vaults, you inherit the liquidation profiles of everyone else in that contract. Our approach on Vanna isolates every position inside its own Soroban SmartAccount contract instance.

Here is how the architecture handles execution on testnet:

First, each SmartAccount holds its own storage keys for collateral and debt positions. Your leveraged b-token balance never mingles with pooled contract balances.

Second, rebalances and flash-executions hit Stellar ledgers at roughly 0.00014 XLM fixed gas per call. This eliminates the gas spikes common on EVM rollups during volatility.

Third, state synchronization runs off a dedicated Mercury indexer instance with latency sitting right at ~320ms. Liquidations and automated rebalances trigger locally if your position approaches our mandatory 1.10x Health Factor floor.

If you want to test leveraged b-token routing, testnet contracts are live. You can deploy your testnet SmartAccount sandbox at test.stellar.vanna.finance and walk through the contracts.

Disclosure: I am a core engineer building on Vanna Protocol.
